args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback endpoint was unavailable (503), so the healthy version was deployed directly; deployment to v2.3.0 completed successfully.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an elevated error rate (0.18).

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool returned 503 (unavailable) on three attempts, so I used the `deploy` tool to deploy the healthy v2.3.0 to all production regions instead. The deployment completed successfully.

4. **Verified**: `checkout-api` is now healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

5. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: the rollback endpoint was unavailable, so the recovery was performed via a direct deploy of the known-good version — same end state, all regions on v2.3.0.
